uniqueFindings.excerpt:
The Sideline Coach repository recognizes exactly **three** report root folder names — `'Reports-SLC'`, `'Reports'`, and `'Docs REPORT'` — defined as the frozen `RECOGNIZED_REPORT_ROOT_NAMES` constant in `src/game-filesystem-contract.ts` (line 24). Among these, `'Reports-SLC'` is designated the canonical preferred name (`CANONICAL_REPORTS_ROOT_NAME`, line 17). This three-name vocabulary is locked against drift by a regression test at `test/report-glob-policy.test.mjs` (line 84, test S7.1-8), and the `buildReportGlobs()` function in `report-glob-policy.ts` ensures all three are always emitted as default discovery patterns regardless of user configuration.
